{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique()
completed_status = df['status'].unique()
revenue_example = df['revenue'].iloc[0]
qa_filter = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_count = df[qa_filter].shape[0]

# Print all verification results
print(f"LOYAL customers exist: {loyal_exists}")
print(f"Status values: {completed_status}")
print(f"Revenue example (before parsing): {revenue_example}")
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue=999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Print number of rows in this group
print(f"Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
loyal_completed['revenue_float'] = loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print mean revenue
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
